note: XXII fill shots, recipe B (daylight: 3 Oct)
style: An oil painting of 1893, painted alla prima in the manner of Sargent, Atkinson Grimshaw and the Victorian narrative painters: visible loose brushstrokes, thick impasto in the lights, thin transparent glazes in the shadows, soft lost edges, broken colour, canvas weave showing through; brilliant autumn daylight, strong raking sun and crisp deep shadows, glowing sky, rich saturated colour; figures small, unidealised, painted in a few strokes. Not an illustration, not digital art. One single painting filling the whole 16:9 frame, no text, lettering, signature, border or black bars.

beats.text: Shot: establishing, far. The gothic red-brick asylum at Purfleet early on a clear October morning after a terrible night: low gold sun, long shadows across dewy lawns, smoke rising straight from the chimneys, rooks over the bare trees.

Shot: very wide interior, figures small and faces not seen. A doctor's study on a bright morning: sun pouring through tall windows across a long table strewn with papers, typed sheets and a map, a group of men and one woman in a dark dress seated round it, seen from the far end of the room.

Shot: wide interior, no faces. Looking out through a tall sash window of the asylum study into a sunlit autumn garden; on the sill a vase of late roses; the back of a young woman in a dark dress standing at the window, small, looking out.

Shot: establishing, far. Over a high old garden wall on a bright October morning: the deserted mansion of Carfax with its ruined chapel, ivy, broken windows and rooks wheeling over the trees, sunlit and silent.

Shot: close, no people. A large old map of London spread on a sunlit study table, held flat by an inkwell and a lamp base, pencil marks and small paper slips laid on it, a magnifying glass; all lettering is loose and unreadable.

Shot: establishing, far. A tall stone-fronted London mansion in Piccadilly, 1893, with a bow window and high steps up to the door, the windows encrusted with dust and the shutters up, on a bright autumn afternoon; cabs and omnibuses passing, smart crowds on the pavement.

Shot: very wide. Piccadilly on a sunny October afternoon, 1893: a long sweep of grand stone houses, hansom cabs and a red omnibus, gentlemen in top hats, the trees of Green Park turning gold on the other side.

Shot: wide. A London mews stable yard in morning sun: fine saddle horses being groomed and led out by grooms, straw, a water trough, sunlight through the open doors; two gentlemen small in the background.

Shot: far, exterior, looking in. From the sunlit garden through the tall window of a study: inside, a small group bent over a table of papers and maps around a young woman in dark dress; brick, ivy and autumn sun on the glass.
Shot: medium, no people. A sunlit corner of a study: an empty armchair by a tall window with a lace curtain moving in the breeze, a dropped handkerchief on the floor, motes in the light.
Shot: very wide. A steam train of 1893 running along the Thames marshes towards London on a bright day, white steam trailing, barges with red sails on the river, gulls, a wide luminous sky.

Shot: establishing, far. A London railway terminus at midday, 1893: under a great iron-and-glass roof full of sunlit steam, a train just arrived, porters and passengers crowding the platform; three gentlemen walking small towards the cabs.

Shot: wide. Green Park in golden October sun, 1893: three gentlemen in dark coats sitting small on a bench under the trees, looking across the railings at the stone mansions of Piccadilly; nursemaids and children on the grass.

Shot: wide interior, no people. The dusty entrance hall of a long-shut London mansion: shafts of afternoon sun through closed shutters, dust in the air, dust sheets over furniture, a great staircase rising into shadow.
Shot: establishing, far. The asylum grounds at noon in brilliant October sun: a gravel drive, clipped yews, a stone statue, a carriage waiting at the door, the gothic red-brick front glowing.
